newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTLOOK POSITIVE FOR BIG FINNISH EXPORT INDUSTRIES.
newsitem.headline: OUTLOOK POSITIVE FOR BIG FINNISH EXPORT INDUSTRIES.

text.p: The Confederation of Finnish Industry and Employers (TT) on Thursday said the outlook was brightening for Finland's biggest export industries.

"Early this autumn, cyclical expectations have improved significantly in the forest and metal industries, and prospects have improved somewhat also in the chemical industry," TT said in its quarterly cyclical barometer.

In January-July, the metal industry -- which includes base metals, engineering and electrotechnical production -- and the forest and chemical industries together stood for 91 percent of the value of Finnish exports, according to customs board data.
Looking six months ahead from October, the TT barometer said output growth prospects were "most favourable in the metal and forest industries."

Expectations of a pick-up in new orders were especially bright in the forest, metal and chemical industries. Forest industry respondents said the inflow of new export orders had exceeded expectations.
"By the end of the year, export orders will increase further especially in the forest, metal and chemical industries," TT said.
